stemMd: A molecule consists of glycerol esterified to three fatty acids. Which property is most consistent with that structure?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It forms the catalytic RNA of a ribosome.

options.label: B
options.textMd: It carries codons for protein synthesis.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It serves as a concentrated hydrophobic energy store.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It is the main structural component of a DNA strand.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It is a chain of glucose units.

explanationMd: Glycerol linked by ester bonds to three fatty acids forms a triacylglycerol. Its long hydrocarbon chains are reduced and largely hydrophobic, making the molecule an efficient energy reserve. Unlike phospholipids, it lacks a large polar head suited to forming a bilayer.

distractorRationale.b: Codons are sequences in nucleic acids.
distractorRationale.e: Glycerol and fatty acids are not a polysaccharide chain.
